hreflangReasoning: Use the language-only code 'vi', not 'vi-VN'. Vietnamese has one real market (Vietnam). Diaspora searchers in the US, Australia and France use the same words, so region variants would be duplicates. No page content differs by region: no prices, currency or legal text. Google accepts language-only codes. SavePin and KlickPin label their Vietnamese pages 'vi'. pinterestdownloader.io uses 'vi-VN' in hreflang but an invalid lang='vi-02', and its canonical points to the English page, which wastes its own vi page. Every vi page lists itself as 'vi', its English twin as 'en', and x-default (English). Skipped pages get no vi alternate.

markets.pinterestHost: www.pinterest.com and pin.it short links. Pinterest has no vn.pinterest.com (it did not answer). www.pinterest.com.vn and www.pinterest.vn both 307-redirect to www.pinterest.com, so the URL classifier needs no new host.
markets.notes: Mobile-first market. People use 'tải' (download) far more than 'lưu' (save), and almost never 'download'. The top modifiers are destination ('về máy tính', 'về điện thoại', 'về máy'), 'không logo' (meaning watermark-free), quality ('hd', 'full hd', '4k', 'nét', 'không bị mờ', 'chất lượng cao'), 'miễn phí', 'bằng link', and device ('iphone', 'android', 'samsung', 'laptop', 'macbook', 'ipad'). Cốc Cốc, a local Chromium browser with a built-in video downloader, appears in queries and in ranking guides.

urlStructure.pattern: /vi for the homepage, /vi/<slug> for the others. No trailing slash, which matches normalizeCanonical and the seo-invariants test.
urlStructure.transliteration: Remove all diacritics and use lowercase ASCII with hyphens. Map đ/Đ to d, never 'dd'. Example: 'tải video pinterest về điện thoại' becomes tai-video-pinterest-ve-dien-thoai. Vietnamese publishers that rank (dienmayxanh, gearvn, cellphones) use the same convention. Google matches these slugs to both accented and unaccented queries.
urlStructure.competitorGap: No downloader competitor uses Vietnamese slugs. KlickPin uses /vi/pin-board-downloader, SavePin /pinterest-downloader/vi/download-pinterest-image, and pinterestdownloader.io /vi-02/pinterest-image-downloader-05. Slugs built from the exact query tokens are a cheap relevance edge.

glossary.voice: Address the reader as 'bạn', as Pinterest's Vietnamese help does. Never use 'quý khách' (too formal) or 'mình/cậu' (too chatty). Use sentence case in titles and headings ('Tải video Pinterest về máy tính'), not Title Case Per Syllable: competitors' Title Case looks machine-made, and Pinterest and the editorial sites use sentence case.

ui.download (verb in headings/keywords): tải; with a destination 'tải về máy', 'tải về điện thoại'
ui.save to device: lưu về máy. Never label our button just 'Lưu', because Pinterest's 'Lưu' means save to a board
ui.paste box placeholder: Dán link Ghim, bảng hoặc hồ sơ Pinterest…
ui.link / URL: link in our own copy (people search 'bằng link'); 'liên kết' only when quoting Pinterest UI ('Sao chép liên kết'); avoid 'URL'
ui.copy link: Sao chép liên kết (exact Pinterest label)
ui.processing: Đang lấy file… (the current i18n string 'Đang trích xuất media HD…' is stiff and overclaims HD)
ui.file: file; 'tệp' only for the iOS Files app ('Tệp')
ui.HD / sharp: HD, nét; 'chất lượng cao'. Blurry = 'mờ', pixelated = 'vỡ'
ui.watermark: logo, as in 'không chèn logo'. People search 'không logo' and 'không dính logo'; 'hình mờ' and 'watermark' are rare
ui.public / private: công khai / riêng tư; secret board = bảng bí mật
ui.FAQ heading: Câu hỏi thường gặp (the current i18n 'Hỏi đáp' is fine but less standard)
ui.wrong link type: Đây là link bảng. Hãy dùng công cụ Tải bảng Pinterest.
ui.not found / private: Không tìm thấy Ghim công khai. Ghim có thể riêng tư hoặc đã bị xóa.

product.browser extension: tiện ích mở rộng / tiện ích / extension
product.credit creators: ghi nguồn tác giả (common Vietnamese web phrase 'nhớ ghi nguồn')

claimTicket.concept: Every Vietnamese reader knows the claim ticket from motorbike parking ('vé gửi xe'): you hand over the bike, get a numbered ticket, and give it back to collect the bike. A link is the ticket and the file is what you collect.

formats.numbers: Thousands '.', decimal ','. Write 1.200, 2,4 MB, 50%. Use Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN'). Keep video tiers as 720p and 1080p, dimensions as 600×600 or 1200px, and file names as written.
formats.dates: dd/mm/yyyy (15/10/2026), or long form 'ngày 15 tháng 10 năm 2026'. Month names stay lowercase ('tháng 10'). Use Intl.DateTimeFormat('vi-VN'). Blog byline: '15/10/2026 · 5 phút đọc'.
formats.currency: VND as '0 ₫', symbol after the number, no decimals. Not needed: say 'miễn phí'.
formats.quotes: Curly double quotes “…” for UI labels in prose, or bold the Pinterest label instead (Sao chép liên kết)

typography.glyphCoverage: Blocker. src/styles/ticket.css self-hosts only the Big Shoulders Display latin subset (U+0000-00FF etc.). Vietnamese letters (Ả Ấ Ộ Ư Ơ Đ ă đ …) are not in it. fontkitten confirms that Ả Ế Ộ Đ Ơ Ư ă đ are missing from the latin 900 file, so the browser falls back glyph by glyph to Arial Narrow or system sans, and a headline like 'TẢI VIDEO' mixes two typefaces inside one word. Fix: copy big-shoulders-display-vietnamese-800/900-normal.woff2 from node_modules/@fontsource/big-shoulders-display (900 is 4.6 KB) to public/fonts, add @font-face rules with unicode-range U+0102-0103,U+0110-0111,U+0128-0129,U+0168-0169,U+01A0-01A1,U+01AF-01B0,U+0300-0301,U+0303-0304,U+0308-0309,U+0323,U+0329,U+1EA0-1EF9,U+20AB, and preload them only on /vi pages. fontkitten check of all 146 Vietnamese letters (12 vowels × 6 tones, both cases, plus đ/Đ) at weights 800 and 900: 102 are missing from the self-hosted latin file, and none are missing once the vietnamese subset is added. latin-ext is not needed.
typography.verticalMetrics: Measured in Big Shoulders 900 (UPM 2000): cap height 0.80em, ascent 0.984em. The tallest stacked capital (Ắ) reaches 1.158em above the baseline, and dot-below (Ậ) reaches -0.139em.
typography.lineHeight: Change needed. At the display line-height 0.88-0.9, a stacked mark on line 2 rises about 0.28em into line 1's capitals. At 46px that is a 12px overlap. 12 of the 16 vi H1s wrap to 2-3 lines at 375px, and all 16 wrap at 320px. Set line-height to at least 1.2 for :lang(vi) display, headline and tool-body H2s; 1.3 fully clears dot-below over a stacked cap. Check the hero-seam alignment again after the change.
typography.topClip: .seam-hero uses overflow: clip, and phone hero top padding is 12px. Stacked marks on the first H1 line stand about 0.36em (16px at 46px) above the cap line, so keep at least 0.4em clear above the H1, or marks on words such as 'TẢI', 'LƯU' and 'CÁCH' get cut.
typography.uppercase: text-transform: uppercase is safe for Vietnamese: no special casing, đ becomes Đ. Set html lang='vi' so :lang(vi) rules apply.
typography.labels: Label and serial styles (gothic 800 at 0.875rem with 0.08em tracking) squeeze stacked marks to about 2px. Consider 0.9375rem for vi labels, and keep them short ('VÉ VÀO CỬA · LINK CÔNG KHAI').
typography.lengthExpansion: Vietnamese ran about 10-25% longer than English. The first-draft meta descriptions were 159-169 chars and had to be cut to 144-158. Every H1 fits at 375px: longest word 'PINTEREST' is 173px of 343px, and H1s take 1-3 lines (3 lines on 3 pages at 375px and on 8 pages at 320px). Words are short syllables, so condensed width is not a problem; height is.
typography.lineBreaks: Browsers may break between the syllables of a two-syllable word ('thư | viện', 'điện | thoại'). Optionally join key pairs in H1s with a non-breaking space ('thư viện ảnh', 'điện thoại'), and keep '4K' with the word before it.
typography.unicodeNormalization: Store every string as NFC (precomposed). seo_health_check.py counts len() on parsed text, and NFD text (common when copying from macOS) counts 2-3 code points per accented letter, which can push a 156-char description past 160. NFD also relies on the font's combining-mark positioning. Add a test: str === str.normalize('NFC').
typography.toneMarkStyle: Pick one tone-mark placement and use it everywhere. Recommended: the modern style ('hòa', 'thủy', 'khỏe', 'xóa'), with 'kỹ' not 'kĩ'. Autocomplete mixes both ('xoá ghim pinterest'), so mixing will not hurt search but looks careless.

notes: Publish 16 of 19 pages; skip carousel, story and the SEO title generator (reasons in pages[].skipReason). Priority P1 (biggest evidence): /vi, tai-video-pinterest, tai-anh-pinterest, cach-tai-video-pinterest, tai-video-pinterest-ve-may-tinh, tai-video-pinterest-ve-dien-thoai. P2: ghim, gif, bảng, avatar, nhạc, thư viện ảnh. P3: hồ sơ, 4K, MP4, Chrome.

'không logo' is the strongest modifier in this market ('tải video pinterest không logo', '… miễn phí', '… trên iphone', '… trên máy tính', 'không dính logo'). Claim only what is true: PintDownload does not add a logo, and the file is the MP4 Pinterest serves. Logos already burned into the creator's video (TikTok, CapCut) stay. Check that the extracted pinimg MP4 has no Pinterest end-card before putting 'không logo' in titles.

Honest quality copy: extract/media.ts says /originals/ returns 403 and 1200x is the largest public image, video is usually 720p with 1080p when listed, and avatars are about 600×600. So never write 'ảnh gốc', 'chất lượng gốc', 'Full HD' (as a promise), '2K' or '4K', even though 'tải ảnh pinterest gốc', 'tải avatar pinterest full hd' and '4k' are real queries. The vi 4K page answers the 4K question honestly. Do not translate the English 4K page: it claims '4K ultra quality' and 'original uncompressed' and should be fixed too.

The current vi strings in src/lib/i18n.ts overclaim and read as machine translation. heroSubtitle promises 'Full HD 1080p'; the tool labels use Title Case ('Tải Bảng', 'Tải Hồ Sơ'); 'Đang trích xuất media HD…'. Replace them with glossary terms when the vi pages ship.
Pinterest's 'Lưu' means save to a board, not to the device. How-to copy must say so, because people search 'lưu video pinterest' meaning save to the phone. Pinterest's own help draws the same line.

iPhone how-to: every ranking Vietnamese guide still routes iPhone users through the third-party Documents app. A simpler, correct flow is Safari → Tải xuống → Tệp → Tải về → Chia sẻ → Lưu video, with no app needed. That is a differentiator, but check the iOS 17/18 Vietnamese labels on a device before shipping screenshots.

Cốc Cốc, a Vietnamese Chromium browser with a built-in media download button, shows up in queries ('cốc cốc tải video pinterest về máy tính', '… không có logo') and in viettablet's guide. The laptop and Chrome pages should mention that the bookmarklet and paste box also work in Cốc Cốc. Never imply a partnership.

Trust is a ranking and conversion lever: users ask 'tải video pinterest an toàn không', 'klickpin safe' and 'web tải … uy tín'. One competitor's vi page links to gambling sites, and online gambling ads are illegal in Vietnam. When an ad network is added, block gambling and betting categories for /vi.

Avoid app-install intent: 'tải pinterest về máy tính (win 10 / mac)', 'cách tải pinterest trên iphone 6/7' and 'tải pinterest apk' mean installing the Pinterest app. Don't target bare 'tải pinterest' on any page. Also avoid 'avatar pinterest', 'ảnh đại diện pinterest' and 'gif pinterest' on their own: those queries want inspiration images, not a downloader.

Opportunity, not planned: 'tải ảnh ghép pinterest' has 7 completions ('… không có logo', '… về máy tính', '… về điện thoại'). If the extractor returns the rendered image of a Pinterest collage (Ảnh ghép) Pin, add an FAQ on the image page. Test it first.

Cannibalisation watch: '/vi', '/vi/tai-video-pinterest', '/vi/chuyen-video-pinterest-sang-mp4' and '/vi/cach-tai-video-pinterest' all touch 'tải video pinterest'. Keep the ownership map in keywordOwnership, link each page to the owner with the exact anchor text, and if Search Console shows the homepage winning 'tải video pinterest', point internal anchors at the video page.

Unaccented searches: 'tai video pinterest' returned no completions, while 'tai anh pinterest' and 'cach tai video pinterest' returned the accented versions, so Google folds unaccented input into accented queries. ASCII slugs plus accented titles cover both.
Carousel and Idea Pin content folds into existing FAQs: 'Ghim nhiều ảnh' on the pin page, and 'Ghim video nhiều trang (Ghim ý tưởng cũ)' on the video page.
Phone-only Shortcuts: 'phím tắt tải video pinterest' exists, but PintDownload has no iOS Shortcut. Answer honestly in the phone guide FAQ, or skip the question.
